caption: A large dog on a leash tied to a post spots a squirrel and lunges after it; the leash snaps taut and the dog is stopped short.

sa.check: A dog is on a leash tied to a post.
A squirrel is what the dog goes for.
The lunge comes first, then the taut leash, then the stop.

pc.expect: The leash goes from slack to straight at the instant the dog reaches its end; it does not stretch like elastic.
pc.fail: The leash stretches on and on as the dog keeps going; or it stays curved while the dog is plainly held; or it goes taut while the dog is still standing.

pc.expect: The dog stops at the instant the leash goes tight and not before.
pc.fail: The dog stops before the leash straightens; or it keeps running past the leash's length; or it is thrown back before the leash is taut.

pc.expect: The post holds and does not move, and the dog is jerked back or pulled up.
pc.fail: The post bends or comes out of the ground; or the dog keeps going with the leash trailing; or the leash detaches without breaking.

pc.expect: The taut leash runs straight from collar to post, and a slack leash droops.
pc.fail: A slack leash floats in a curve above the ground; or the taut leash sags; or the dog is lifted off the ground.

pc.expect: One dog, one leash and one post keep their number and shape.
pc.fail: The leash passes through the dog or the post; or the dog duplicates; or the leash vanishes.

pc.expect: The dog's coat, the leash and the post stay the same.
pc.fail: The coat changes pattern; or the leash changes colour; or the post changes between frames.

note: The dog is self-driven: its speed, reaction and where it looks are not judged. Only the leash's response and the timing of the stop are.
